CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.course_entry_review_trg_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status in ('rejected', 'more_evidence', 'returned_layer2', 'returned_layer3', 'superseded') then
    perform security.course_entry_review_apply_v1(new.id, new.status, null, 'Layer 4 ' || new.status);
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.entry_matrix_review_trg_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status in ('rejected', 'more_evidence', 'returned_layer2', 'returned_layer3', 'superseded') then
    perform security.entry_matrix_review_apply_v1(new.id, new.status, null, 'Layer 4 ' || new.status);
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.layer4_evidence_link_trg_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
-- Trigger layer4_review_items_zz_evidence (BEFORE INSERT): a new waiting item of a kind in layer4.evidence_link_kinds that arrives without a
-- stored copy gets the newest stored copy of its page. No read is made; nothing else changes.
begin
  if new.evidence_id is null and new.status = 'pending' and security.pipeline_num_v1('layer4.evidence_link_on', 1) >= 1
     and new.field_code = any (security.pipeline_list_v1('layer4.evidence_link_kinds', '[]'::jsonb)) then
    new.evidence_id := security.layer4_stored_copy_v1(security.layer4_item_page_v1(new.field_code, new.proposed_value, new.layer2_state));
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.no_page_review_trg_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status in ('rejected', 'more_evidence', 'returned_layer2', 'returned_layer3', 'superseded') then
    perform security.no_page_review_apply_v1(new.id, new.status, null, 'Layer 4 ' || new.status);
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.ops_guard_layer4_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
-- While a remedy runs a Layer 4 item may only stay pending or be superseded (duplicate reconciliation); approving, rejecting, returning or
-- deleting is a decision (mandate §10: technical repair authority is not admission authority).
begin
  if TG_OP = 'DELETE' or new.status not in ('pending', 'superseded') or (TG_OP = 'UPDATE' and old.status <> 'pending' and new.status is distinct from old.status) then
    raise exception 'ops guard: a remedy cannot decide or admit a Layer 4 item' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.provider_description_review_trg_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update pipeline.provider_description_reads set
         state = case when new.status = 'rejected' then 'rejected' when new.status in ('more_evidence', 'returned_layer2', 'returned_layer3') then 'held' when new.status = 'superseded' then 'superseded' else state end,
         rule = case when new.status in ('approved', 'edited_approved') then rule else 'layer4_' || new.status end,
         updated_at = now()
   where review_item_id = new.id and state = 'proposed' and new.status not in ('approved', 'edited_approved');
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_provider_policies_read(p_kind text DEFAULT 'english_policy'::text, p_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v jsonb;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or security.current_role_rank() < 4 then raise exception 'Pipeline Operator role required' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  if p_kind not in ('english_policy', 'intake_calendar') then raise exception 'kind must be english_policy or intake_calendar'; end if;
  if p_id is not null then
    select jsonb_build_object('proposal', to_jsonb(x) - 'content_hash', 'provider', coalesce(p.display_name, p.canonical_name),
             'rows', case when x.kind = 'english_policy' then (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('course_id', r.course_id, 'title', r.title, 'study_level', r.study_level,
                   'plan', r.plan, 'reason', r.reason, 'outcome', r.outcome, 'existing', r.existing,
                   'ielts', (select q->'overall_score' from jsonb_array_elements(r.requirements) q where q->>'test_code' = 'IELTS' limit 1))
                   order by case r.outcome when 'write' then 0 when 'differs' then 1 when 'agrees' then 2 else 3 end, r.title), '[]'::jsonb)
                   from security.provider_english_plan_v1(x.id) r) end)
      into v from pipeline.provider_policy_proposals x join catalogue.providers p on p.id = x.provider_id
     where x.id = p_id and x.kind = p_kind;
    if v is null then raise exception 'proposal not found'; end if;
    return v;
  end if;
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'can_decide', security.current_role_rank() >= 6,
    'totals', jsonb_build_object(
      'documents_found', (select count(*) from pipeline.provider_fact_sources f where f.kind = p_kind),
      'documents_read', (select count(*) from pipeline.provider_fact_sources f where f.kind = p_kind and f.status in ('read', 'parsed', 'no_values')),
      'providers_found', (select count(distinct f.provider_id) from pipeline.provider_fact_sources f where f.kind = p_kind),
      'no_values_by_style', (select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(coalesce(style, 'none'), n), '{}'::jsonb) from (select style, count(*) n from pipeline.provider_policy_proposals
                               where kind = p_kind and status = 'no_values' group by 1) s)),
    'proposals', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
         'id', x.id, 'provider_id', x.provider_id, 'provider', coalesce(p.display_name, p.canonical_name), 'country', k.iso_alpha2,
         'url', x.url, 'style', x.style, 'status', x.status, 'parser', x.parser, 'created_at', x.created_at,
         'decided_at', x.decided_at, 'decision_note', x.decision_note, 'apply_summary', x.apply_summary,
         'caveats', x.proposal->'caveats', 'conflicts', x.proposal->'conflicts',
         'defaults', x.proposal->'defaults', 'periods', x.proposal->'periods',
         'named_requirements', (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(x.proposal->'exceptions', '[]'::jsonb)) e where jsonb_typeof(e->'reqs') = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(e->'reqs') > 0),
         'named_courses', jsonb_array_length(coalesce(x.proposal->'named', '[]'::jsonb)),
         'plan', x.plan_summary, 'plan_at', x.plan_at)
       order by (x.status = 'proposed') desc, coalesce(p.display_name, p.canonical_name)), '[]'::jsonb)
       from pipeline.provider_policy_proposals x join catalogue.providers p on p.id = x.provider_id left join ref.countries k on k.id = p.country_id
      where x.kind = p_kind and x.status in ('proposed', 'approved', 'rejected'))) into v;
  return v;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.central_ai_enqueue_v1(p_provider uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_n int;
begin
  if not coalesce((select s.enabled from pipeline.central_ai_settings s where s.id = 1), false) then return 0; end if;
  insert into pipeline.central_ai_queue(fact_source_id, provider_id, kind, content_hash)
  select f.id, f.provider_id, f.kind, f.content_hash from pipeline.provider_fact_sources f
    join pipeline.evidence_artifacts e on e.id = f.evidence_id and e.storage_path is not null
   where f.provider_id = p_provider and f.kind in ('english_policy', 'intake_calendar') and f.status in ('read', 'parsed', 'no_values')
     and not exists (select 1 from pipeline.provider_policy_proposals pp where pp.fact_source_id = f.id and pp.status in ('proposed', 'approved'))
     and not exists (select 1 from pipeline.central_ai_queue q where q.fact_source_id = f.id and (q.state in ('queued', 'leased') or q.content_hash is not distinct from f.content_hash))
  on conflict do nothing;
  get diagnostics v_n = row_count;
  return v_n;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.central_pages_attach_v1()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_att int := 0; v_q int := 0; v_re int := 0; v_max int := security.pipeline_num_v1('central.attach_per_kind', 3)::int; r record;
begin
  -- a university with no approved English rule gets its best suggested central English page not yet tried
  insert into pipeline.provider_fact_sources(provider_id, kind, url, title, rank, found_via, status)
  select x.provider_id, 'english_policy', x.url, left(x.title, 200), 5, 'search', 'found'
    from (select s.provider_id, e->>'url' url, e->>'title' title,
                 row_number() over (partition by s.provider_id order by (e->>'score')::numeric desc) rn
            from pipeline.provider_central_search s cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(s.found, '[]'::jsonb)) e
           where e->>'kind' = 'english_policy' and coalesce((e->>'score')::numeric, 0) >= security.pipeline_num_v1('central.min_suggest_score', 4)
             and e->>'url' ~ '^https?://'
             and not exists (select 1 from pipeline.provider_fact_sources f where f.provider_id = s.provider_id and f.kind = 'english_policy' and f.url = e->>'url')) x
   where x.rn = 1
     and not exists (select 1 from pipeline.provider_policy_proposals pp where pp.provider_id = x.provider_id and pp.kind = 'english_policy' and pp.status in ('approved', 'proposed'))
     and not exists (select 1 from pipeline.provider_fact_sources f where f.provider_id = x.provider_id and f.kind = 'english_policy' and f.status in ('found', 'reading'))
     and (select count(*) from pipeline.provider_fact_sources f where f.provider_id = x.provider_id and f.kind = 'english_policy') < v_max
     and exists (select 1 from catalogue.courses c where c.provider_id = x.provider_id and c.lifecycle_status = 'active')
     and not exists (select 1 from security.provider_hidden_v1 h where h.provider_id = x.provider_id)
  on conflict (provider_id, kind, url) do nothing;
  get diagnostics v_att = row_count;
  -- a university with no approved rule and no suggested central English page left is searched again (job central-find)
  update pipeline.provider_central_search s set state = 'queued', attempts = 0, leased_until = null, updated_at = now()
   where s.provider_id in (
     select s2.provider_id from pipeline.provider_central_search s2
      where s2.state in ('done', 'failed') and s2.updated_at < now() - make_interval(days => security.pipeline_num_v1('central.research_days', 7)::int)
        and not exists (select 1 from pipeline.provider_policy_proposals pp where pp.provider_id = s2.provider_id and pp.kind = 'english_policy' and pp.status in ('approved', 'proposed'))
        and not exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(s2.found, '[]'::jsonb)) e
                         where e->>'kind' = 'english_policy' and coalesce((e->>'score')::numeric, 0) >= security.pipeline_num_v1('central.min_suggest_score', 4)
                           and not exists (select 1 from pipeline.provider_fact_sources f where f.provider_id = s2.provider_id and f.kind = 'english_policy' and f.url = e->>'url'))
        and not exists (select 1 from pipeline.provider_fact_sources f where f.provider_id = s2.provider_id and f.kind = 'english_policy' and f.status in ('found', 'reading'))
        and not exists (select 1 from security.provider_hidden_v1 h where h.provider_id = s2.provider_id)
        and exists (select 1 from catalogue.courses c where c.provider_id = s2.provider_id and c.lifecycle_status = 'active')
      order by (select count(*) from catalogue.courses c2 where c2.provider_id = s2.provider_id and c2.lifecycle_status = 'active') desc
      limit greatest(0, security.pipeline_num_v1('central.research_per_run', 30)::int - (select count(*) from pipeline.provider_central_search q where q.state in ('queued', 'leased'))::int));
  get diagnostics v_re = row_count;
  -- read central English pages go to the pinned AI (the database checks each quote; policy-auto-approve decides)
  for r in select distinct f.provider_id from pipeline.provider_fact_sources f
            where f.kind = 'english_policy' and f.status in ('read', 'parsed', 'no_values')
              and not exists (select 1 from pipeline.provider_policy_proposals pp where pp.provider_id = f.provider_id and pp.kind = 'english_policy' and pp.status = 'approved') loop
    v_q := v_q + security.central_ai_enqueue_v1(r.provider_id);
  end loop;
  return jsonb_build_object('attached', v_att, 'searched_again', v_re, 'queued_for_ai', v_q);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.english_level_apply_all_v1(p_apply boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare p uuid; v jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
begin
  for p in select distinct provider_id from pipeline.provider_policy_proposals
            where kind = 'english_policy' and status = 'approved' and jsonb_typeof(proposal->'levels') = 'object' loop
    v := v || jsonb_build_object(p::text, security.english_level_apply_v1(p, p_apply));
  end loop;
  return v;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.english_level_group(p_code text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case when p_code in ('bachelor', 'bachelor_honours', 'associate_degree') then 'undergraduate'
              when p_code in ('graduate_certificate', 'graduate_diploma', 'masters', 'masters_coursework', 'masters_extended') then 'postgraduate'
              when p_code in ('doctorate', 'masters_research') then 'research' end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.english_level_key(p text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select nullif(btrim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(p, '')), '[“”"''’‘`:;,()]', ' ', 'g'), '\s+', ' ', 'g'), '(\d)\.0(?![0-9])', '\1', 'g')), '')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.english_policy_in_force_v1(p_provider_id uuid, p_apply boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare r record; d record; c record; p pipeline.provider_policy_proposals%rowtype;
        v_items jsonb := '[]'::jsonb; v_stripped jsonb := '[]'::jsonb; v_moved int := 0; v_l4 int := 0; v_closed int := 0; v_l4_courses uuid[] := '{}';
        v_day text := to_char(now() at time zone 'Australia/Melbourne', 'FMDD Mon YYYY');
        v_ref text := 'CF-CHG-20260915-247; Decision 262 (one English policy in force per university and level)';
begin
  for r in
    with docs as (
      select pp.id, lv, pp.decided_at,
             pp.url !~* '(/courses?/|english-for-academic|/bengaluru/)' page_ok,
             not exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(pp.proposal->'defaults'->lv) e where coalesce(e->>'quote', '') = '') quoted,
             (select count(*) from catalogue.course_english_requirements cr join catalogue.courses co on co.id = cr.course_id
                left join ref.study_levels sl on sl.id = co.study_level_id
               where cr.source_requirement_key like 'policy:' || pp.id || ':%' and cr.status = 'active' and security.english_level_group(sl.code) = lv) rows_lv
        from pipeline.provider_policy_proposals pp, jsonb_object_keys(coalesce(pp.proposal->'defaults', '{}'::jsonb)) lv
       where pp.provider_id = p_provider_id and pp.kind = 'english_policy' and pp.status = 'approved'
         and lv in ('undergraduate', 'postgraduate', 'research')
         and jsonb_typeof(pp.proposal->'defaults'->lv) = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(pp.proposal->'defaults'->lv) > 0)
    select docs.lv, array_agg(docs.id order by docs.page_ok desc, docs.quoted desc, docs.rows_lv desc, docs.decided_at desc nulls last) ids
      from docs group by docs.lv having count(*) > 1
  loop
    select * into p from pipeline.provider_policy_proposals where id = r.ids[1];
    for d in select * from pipeline.provider_policy_proposals where id = any (r.ids[2:]) loop
      for c in select cr.id rid, cr.course_id, t.code test, cr.overall_score v
                 from catalogue.course_english_requirements cr join ref.english_tests t on t.id = cr.english_test_id
                 join catalogue.courses co on co.id = cr.course_id left join ref.study_levels sl on sl.id = co.study_level_id
                where cr.source_requirement_key like 'policy:' || d.id || ':%' and cr.status = 'active'
                  and security.english_level_group(sl.code) = r.lv and cr.notes like 'Default for %' loop
        if exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p.proposal->'defaults'->r.lv) e where e->>'test_code' = c.test and (e->>'overall_score')::numeric = c.v) then
          if p_apply then
            update catalogue.course_english_requirements
               set source_requirement_key = 'policy:' || p.id || ':' || lower(c.test), evidence_id = coalesce(p.evidence_id, evidence_id), last_verified_at = now(),
                   notes = notes || format(' In force from %s: %s (one English policy per university and level).', v_day, p.url)
             where id = c.rid;
          end if;
          v_moved := v_moved + 1;
        elsif not c.course_id = any (v_l4_courses) then
          v_l4_courses := v_l4_courses || c.course_id;
          if p_apply and not exists (select 1 from pipeline.layer4_review_items i where i.entity_type = 'course' and i.entity_id = c.course_id
                                                                                 and i.field_code = 'course_english' and i.status = 'pending') then
            insert into pipeline.layer4_review_items(entity_type, entity_id, field_code, evidence_id, before_value, proposed_value, layer2_state, layer3_state,
                                                     status, escalation_reason, change_control_ref, created_at)
            values ('course', c.course_id, 'course_english', p.evidence_id,
                    (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('test', t2.code, 'overall', x.overall_score) order by t2.code), '[]'::jsonb)
                       from catalogue.course_english_requirements x join ref.english_tests t2 on t2.id = x.english_test_id where x.course_id = c.course_id and x.status = 'active'),
                    jsonb_build_object('english_requirements', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('test_code', e->>'test_code', 'overall_score', (e->>'overall_score')::numeric,
                                         'component_scores', coalesce(e->'component_scores', '{}'::jsonb), 'notes', 'From the English policy in force: ' || p.url))
                                                                from jsonb_array_elements(p.proposal->'defaults'->r.lv) e)),
                    jsonb_build_object('page', p.url, 'source', 'English policy in force', 'superseded_policy', d.url),
                    '{}'::jsonb, 'pending',
                    format('This university had two approved English policies for %s courses. This course holds %s %s from %s; the policy now in force (%s) gives %s. Please confirm which is right.',
                           r.lv, c.test, c.v, d.url, p.url,
                           (select string_agg((e->>'test_code') || ' ' || (e->>'overall_score'), ', ') from jsonb_array_elements(p.proposal->'defaults'->r.lv) e)),
                    v_ref, now());
            v_l4 := v_l4 + 1;
          end if;
        end if;
      end loop;
      if p_apply then
        update pipeline.provider_policy_proposals
           set proposal = jsonb_set(proposal #- array['defaults', r.lv], '{superseded_defaults}',
                 coalesce(proposal->'superseded_defaults', '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(r.lv, jsonb_build_object('defaults', proposal->'defaults'->r.lv,
                   'in_force', p.id, 'url', p.url, 'at', now()))),
               plan_at = null, updated_at = now()
         where id = d.id;
      end if;
      v_stripped := v_stripped || jsonb_build_object('id', d.id, 'level', r.lv);
      v_items := v_items || jsonb_build_object('level', r.lv, 'in_force', jsonb_build_object('id', p.id, 'url', p.url, 'parser', p.parser),
                                               'gives_up', jsonb_build_object('id', d.id, 'url', d.url, 'parser', d.parser));
    end loop;
  end loop;
  -- a policy left with no level is closed
  select count(*) into v_closed from pipeline.provider_policy_proposals pp
   where pp.provider_id = p_provider_id and pp.kind = 'english_policy' and pp.status = 'approved'
     and not exists (select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(coalesce(pp.proposal->'defaults', '{}'::jsonb)) k
                      where k in ('undergraduate', 'postgraduate', 'research')
                        and jsonb_typeof(pp.proposal->'defaults'->k) = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(pp.proposal->'defaults'->k) > 0
                        and not exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(v_stripped) s where s->>'id' = pp.id::text and s->>'level' = k))
     and exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(v_stripped) s where s->>'id' = pp.id::text);
  if p_apply and v_closed > 0 then
    update pipeline.provider_policy_proposals pp
       set status = 'superseded', decided_at = now(), updated_at = now(),
           decision_note = format('Closed %s: one English policy in force per university and level (Decision 262); its levels are held by another approved policy.', v_day)
     where pp.provider_id = p_provider_id and pp.kind = 'english_policy' and pp.status = 'approved'
       and pp.proposal->'superseded_defaults' is not null
       and not exists (select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(coalesce(pp.proposal->'defaults', '{}'::jsonb)) k
                        where jsonb_typeof(pp.proposal->'defaults'->k) = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(pp.proposal->'defaults'->k) > 0);
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('provider_id', p_provider_id, 'levels', jsonb_array_length(v_items), 'rows_moved', v_moved,
                            'layer4', case when p_apply then v_l4 else cardinality(v_l4_courses) end, 'closed', v_closed, 'items', v_items);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.english_table_plan_v1(p_provider_cricos text, p_programs jsonb, p_minimum jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(course_id uuid, course_cricos text, title text, study_level text, plan text, reason text, program text, requirements jsonb, existing jsonb, comparison text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'catalogue', 'pipeline', 'ref', 'security'
AS $function$
declare v_provider uuid; v_aliases jsonb; v_double text;
begin
  select s.provider_id, coalesce(s.metadata->'aliases','{}'::jsonb), s.metadata->>'double_degree_rule' into v_provider, v_aliases, v_double from pipeline.sources s
   where s.source_type='provider_english_requirements' and s.metadata->>'provider_cricos'=upper(btrim(p_provider_cricos)) limit 1;
  if v_provider is null then raise exception 'no English requirements source for provider %', p_provider_cricos; end if;
  return query
  with t1 as materialized (
    select e->>'name' name, coalesce(e->>'section','coursework') section, e->'requirements' reqs,
           coalesce(v_aliases->>security.english_title_key(e->>'name'), security.english_title_key(e->>'name')) k
      from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_programs,'[]'::jsonb)) e),
  t1t as materialized (select t1.*, security.english_title_tokens(t1.k) tok from t1),
  c as materialized (
    select co.id, co.canonical_title t, security.english_title_key(co.canonical_title) k, sl.code lvl,
           (select min(upper(btrim(cr.registration_code))) from catalogue.course_registrations cr where cr.course_id=co.id and lower(cr.scheme)='cricos') cricos,
           (select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(et.code, r.overall_score),'{}'::jsonb) from catalogue.course_english_requirements r join ref.english_tests et on et.id=r.english_test_id
             where r.course_id=co.id and r.status='active') ex
      from catalogue.courses co left join ref.study_levels sl on sl.id=co.study_level_id
     where co.provider_id=v_provider and co.lifecycle_status='active'),
  ct as materialized (select c.*, security.english_title_tokens(c.k) tok from c),
  m as materialized (
    select ct.*,
           (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',t1.name,'reqs',t1.reqs)) from t1 where t1.k=ct.k) exact,
           exists(select 1 from t1t where t1t.k<>ct.k and (position(t1t.k in ct.k)>0
                  or (select count(*) from unnest(ct.tok) u where u = any(t1t.tok))::numeric / nullif(greatest(cardinality(ct.tok),cardinality(t1t.tok)),0) >= 0.75)) close
      from ct),
  p as materialized (
    select m.*,
      case when m.exact is not null and (select count(distinct x->'reqs') from jsonb_array_elements(m.exact) x)>1 then 'held'
           when m.exact is not null then 'table1'
           when m.lvl='non_aqf_award' or m.lvl is null then 'held'
           when m.t ~* 'exit award' then 'held'
           when m.lvl in ('doctorate','masters_research') then 'held'
           when m.k ~ '/' or m.k ~ ' and (bachelor|master|doctor|graduate|diploma|associate) (of|in) ' then 'held'
           when m.close then 'held'
           else 'minimum' end pl,
      case when m.exact is not null and (select count(distinct x->'reqs') from jsonb_array_elements(m.exact) x)>1 then 'conflicting Table 1 entries for one name'
           when m.exact is not null then null
           when m.lvl is null then 'study level unknown'
           when m.lvl='non_aqf_award' then 'not an award program'
           when m.t ~* 'exit award' then 'exit award only: not an admission program'
           when m.lvl in ('doctorate','masters_research') then 'research degree: Table 1 research rule is not tied to a named program'
           when m.k ~ '/' or m.k ~ ' and (bachelor|master|doctor|graduate|diploma|associate) (of|in) ' then 'double degree: the policy has no double-degree rule'
           when m.close then 'close to a Table 1 program name: review'
           else null end rs
      from m),
  dd as materialized (
    select p.id, comp.ord, btrim(comp.c) c,
           (select t1.reqs from t1 where t1.k=btrim(comp.c) limit 1) t1reqs,
           (select t1.name from t1 where t1.k=btrim(comp.c) limit 1) t1name,
           exists(select 1 from p p2 where p2.k=btrim(comp.c) and p2.pl='minimum') single_min
      from p, regexp_split_to_table(p.k,'/| and (?=(bachelor|master|doctor|graduate|diploma|associate) (of|in) )') with ordinality comp(c,ord)
     where p.rs='double degree: the policy has no double-degree rule'),
  ddr as materialized (
    select dd.id,
           bool_and(dd.t1reqs is not null or dd.single_min) all_known,
           string_agg(dd.c,'; ' order by dd.ord) filter (where dd.t1reqs is null and not dd.single_min) unknown,
           count(distinct dd.t1reqs) n_t1,
           (array_agg(dd.t1reqs order by dd.ord) filter (where dd.t1reqs is not null))[1] reqs,
           string_agg(dd.t1name,' + ' order by dd.ord) filter (where dd.t1name is not null) t1names
      from dd group by dd.id),
  q as materialized (
    select p.*,
      case when ddr.id is null then p.pl
           when not ddr.all_known or ddr.n_t1>1 then 'held'
           when v_double='higher_component_v1' then case when ddr.n_t1=1 then 'table1' else 'minimum' end
           else 'held' end pl2,
      case when ddr.id is null then p.rs
           when not ddr.all_known then 'double degree: component not recognised ('||ddr.unknown||')'
           when ddr.n_t1>1 then 'double degree: components carry different Table 1 requirements'
           when v_double='higher_component_v1' then 'double degree: higher component ('||case when ddr.n_t1=1 then 'Table 1: '||ddr.t1names else 'minimum' end||')'
           else 'double degree trial: would take '||case when ddr.n_t1=1 then 'Table 1 ('||ddr.t1names||')' else 'the minimum' end end rs2,
      case when ddr.id is null then case when p.pl='table1' then p.exact->0->>'name' end
           when ddr.all_known and ddr.n_t1=1 then ddr.t1names end prog2,
      case when ddr.id is null then case when p.pl='table1' then p.exact->0->'reqs' when p.pl='minimum' then p_minimum end
           when ddr.all_known and ddr.n_t1<=1 then coalesce(ddr.reqs,p_minimum) end reqs2
      from p left join ddr on ddr.id=p.id)
  select q.id, q.cricos, q.t, q.lvl, q.pl2, q.rs2, q.prog2, q.reqs2, q.ex,
         case when q.reqs2 is null then null
              when q.ex='{}'::jsonb then 'none'
              when exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(q.reqs2) r
                           where q.ex ? (r->>'test_code') and (q.ex->>(r->>'test_code'))::numeric<>(r->>'overall_score')::numeric) then 'differs'
              when exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(q.reqs2) r where q.ex ? (r->>'test_code')) then 'agrees'
              else 'other_tests_only' end
    from q;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.provider_english_plan_v1(p_proposal_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(course_id uuid, title text, study_level text, plan text, reason text, requirements jsonb, existing jsonb, outcome text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'catalogue', 'pipeline', 'ref', 'security'
AS $function$
declare x pipeline.provider_policy_proposals%rowtype; v_named jsonb; v_defaults jsonb;
begin
  select * into x from pipeline.provider_policy_proposals where id = p_proposal_id;
  if x.id is null or x.kind <> 'english_policy' then raise exception 'not an English policy proposal'; end if;
  v_defaults := coalesce(x.proposal->'defaults', '{}'::jsonb);
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('k', s.k, 'reqs', s.reqs)), '[]'::jsonb) into v_named from (
    select security.english_title_key(n) k, null::jsonb reqs from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(x.proposal->'named', '[]'::jsonb)) n
    union all
    select security.english_title_key(e->>'name'), case when jsonb_typeof(e->'reqs') = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(e->'reqs') > 0
                                                       then (select jsonb_agg(q - 'quote') from jsonb_array_elements(e->'reqs') q) end
      from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(x.proposal->'exceptions', '[]'::jsonb)) e) s where length(s.k) >= 4;
  return query
  with named as materialized (
    select e->>'k' k, nullif(e->'reqs', 'null'::jsonb) reqs,
           array(select distinct t from unnest(regexp_split_to_array(e->>'k', '[ /]+')) t where t not in ('of', 'and', 'in', 'the', '')) toks
      from jsonb_array_elements(v_named) e),
  c0 as materialized (
    select co.id, co.canonical_title t, security.english_title_key(co.canonical_title) k, sl.code lvl
      from catalogue.courses co left join ref.study_levels sl on sl.id = co.study_level_id
     where co.provider_id = x.provider_id and co.lifecycle_status = 'active'),
  c as materialized (
    select c0.*, array(select distinct t from unnest(regexp_split_to_array(c0.k, '[ /]+')) t where t not in ('of', 'and', 'in', 'the', '')) toks,
           case when c0.lvl in ('bachelor', 'bachelor_honours', 'associate_degree') then 'undergraduate'
                when c0.lvl in ('graduate_certificate', 'graduate_diploma', 'masters', 'masters_coursework', 'masters_extended') then 'postgraduate'
                when c0.lvl in ('doctorate', 'masters_research') then 'research' end grp,  -- CF-247 15 Oct: research degrees take the policy's research default
           (select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(et.code, r.overall_score), '{}'::jsonb) from catalogue.course_english_requirements r
              join ref.english_tests et on et.id = r.english_test_id where r.course_id = c0.id and r.status = 'active') ex,
           exists (select 1 from catalogue.course_english_requirements r where r.course_id = c0.id) any_row,
           exists (select 1 from pipeline.manual_locks l where l.entity = 'course' and l.entity_id = c0.id and l.field in ('english', 'english_requirements', 'course_english')) locked,
           exists (select 1 from pipeline.layer4_review_items i where i.entity_type = 'course' and i.entity_id = c0.id and i.field_code = 'course_english' and i.status = 'pending') in_review,
           false in_l3,  -- CF-247 15 Oct 2026 (usage audit D6): Layer 3 is retired, so no course waits for it
           exists (select 1 from pipeline.coverage_course_pages g where g.course_id = c0.id and g.status in ('bound', 'ambiguous')
                      and (g.read_status is null or g.read_status = 'needs_render')) page_waiting
      from c0),
  m as (
    select c.*,
           (select jsonb_agg(distinct named.reqs) from named where named.k = c.k and named.reqs is not null) exact_reqs,
           exists (select 1 from named where named.k = c.k) exact_named,
           exists (select 1 from named where named.k <> c.k and (position(named.k in c.k) > 0 or position(c.k in named.k) > 0
                     or (cardinality(c.toks) > 0 and cardinality(named.toks) > 0
                         and (select count(*) from unnest(c.toks) t where t = any(named.toks))::numeric / greatest(cardinality(c.toks), cardinality(named.toks)) >= 0.75))) close_named,
           case when c.grp is not null then v_defaults->c.grp end dflt
      from c),
  p as (
    select m.*,
           case when m.lvl is null then 'held|study level unknown'
                when m.lvl in ('doctorate', 'masters_research') and jsonb_typeof(v_defaults->'research') is distinct from 'array' then 'held|research degree (the policy states no research requirement)'
                when m.t ~* 'exit award' then 'held|exit award only'
                when (m.k ~ '/' or m.k ~ ' and (bachelor|master|doctor|graduate|diploma|associate) (of|in) ') and not security.double_degree_same_group_v1(m.t, m.grp) then 'held|double degree (its parts are at different levels)'
                when m.exact_reqs is not null and jsonb_array_length(m.exact_reqs) > 1 then 'held|the policy gives this course more than one requirement'
                when m.exact_reqs is not null then 'named|'
                when m.exact_named or m.close_named then 'held|named in the policy (it may have its own requirement)'
                when m.grp is null then 'held|level not covered by the policy default'
                when m.dflt is null or jsonb_typeof(m.dflt) <> 'array' then 'held|the policy gives no default for this level'
                else 'default|' end pr
      from m),
  q as (
    select p.*, split_part(p.pr, '|', 1) pl, nullif(split_part(p.pr, '|', 2), '') rs,
           case when p.pr like 'named|%' then p.exact_reqs->0 when p.pr like 'default|%' then p.dflt end reqs
      from p)
  select q.id, q.t, q.lvl, q.pl, q.rs, q.reqs, q.ex,
         case when q.pl = 'held' then 'held'
              when q.any_row and exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(q.reqs) r where q.ex ? (r->>'test_code') and (q.ex->>(r->>'test_code'))::numeric <> (r->>'overall_score')::numeric) then 'differs'
              when q.any_row and exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(q.reqs) r where q.ex ? (r->>'test_code')) then 'agrees'
              when q.any_row then 'other_value'
              when q.locked then 'set_by_hand'
              when q.in_review then 'in_review'
              when q.in_l3 or q.page_waiting then 'waiting'
              else 'write' end
    from q;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.svc_english_table_preview(p_provider_cricos text, p_programs jsonb, p_minimum jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'security'
AS $function$
declare v jsonb;
begin
  if current_user<>'postgres' and coalesce(auth.role(),'')<>'service_role' then raise exception 'service_role required'; end if;
  with pl as (select * from security.english_table_plan_v1(p_provider_cricos,p_programs,p_minimum)),
       t1 as (select e->>'name' name, e->>'section' section from jsonb_array_elements(p_programs) e)
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'courses',(select count(*) from pl),
    'by_plan',(select jsonb_object_agg(plan,n) from (select plan,count(*) n from pl group by 1) x),
    'by_comparison',(select jsonb_object_agg(plan||':'||comparison,n) from (select plan,comparison,count(*) n from pl where comparison is not null group by 1,2) x),
    'would_write',(select count(*) from pl where plan in ('table1','minimum') and comparison='none' and course_cricos is not null),
    'held_by_reason',(select jsonb_object_agg(reason,n) from (select reason,count(*) n from pl where plan='held' group by 1) x),
    'table1_programs',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('program',t1.name,'section',t1.section,
         'courses',(select count(*) from pl where pl.program=t1.name)) order by t1.name) from t1),
    'table1_not_in_catalogue',(select jsonb_agg(t1.name order by t1.name) from t1 where not exists(select 1 from pl where pl.program=t1.name)),
    'differs',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('title',title,'plan',plan,'program',program,'planned',(select jsonb_object_agg(q->>'test_code',q->'overall_score') from jsonb_array_elements(requirements) q),'existing',existing) order by title) from pl where comparison='differs'),
    'held',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('title',title,'reason',reason,'existing',existing) order by reason,title) from pl where plan='held'),
    'written_sample',(select jsonb_agg(x) from (select jsonb_build_object('title',title,'plan',plan,'ielts',(select q->'overall_score' from jsonb_array_elements(requirements) q where q->>'test_code'='IELTS')) x from pl where plan in ('table1','minimum') and comparison='none' order by plan desc,title limit 12) s)
  ) into v;
  return v;
end $function$
